newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle sells marine insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle sells marine insurance unit.

text.p: American Eagle Group Inc said Thursday its American Eagle Insurance Co unit completed the sale of its marine insurance business.
American Eagle had about $6.6 million in gross written marine premiums in 1996, the company said. It said the effect of the transaction is immaterial to the American Eagle Group.

The transaction included the sale of the furniture and other assets of the company's Baltimore office to American Yachts Ltd and the reinsurance by Underwriters Insurance Co of the company's liability on its yacht insurance policies as of April 30, the company said. Terms were not disclosed.
